findings.claim: the point estimates favour the stacked configuration on every error metric
findings.evidence: paper_data.json final_evaluation.metrics holds only delta_mae_vs_*, delta_score_vs_* and CI fields as baseline contrasts; claims_grounding.json claims 5-8 ground only MAE and utility gains; paper.tex Experimental Protocol (Uncertainty) and Results sections state that baseline Spearman is not retained.
findings.fix: Replace "on every error metric" with "on MAE against all three baselines and on utility against the best baseline", and state that baseline RMSE, Spearman and Kendall were not retained.
findings.issue: The retained outputs give baseline comparisons only for MAE (random mean, anchor points, IRT-style) and for utility against the best baseline. Baseline RMSE, Spearman and Kendall are not retained, and the paper's own Uncertainty paragraph says baseline-specific Spearman values are not part of the retained outputs. The claim therefore covers metrics that were never compared.

findings.claim: it also passes both negative controls (single episodes); passes both negative controls
findings.evidence: claims_grounding.json claim[12] cites only the control_* metric deltas; source_evidence/evaluate_final.py lines ~1241-1255 and ~1272 (controls_ok is completeness/validity only, with no performance threshold); paper_data.json final_evaluation.evaluation_evidence.candidate_diagnostics_trust=unverified; paper.tex Experimental Protocol (Controls and qualification).
findings.fix: Reword to "predictions degrade as expected under both negative controls (single episodes: permuted MAE +0.156, Spearman -1.157; constant MAE +0.094)". Drop "passes", or state explicitly that no pass/fail criterion for the controls is evidenced.
findings.issue: "Passes" implies a pass/fail criterion with a threshold. The evaluator only requires the control episodes to be complete and valid, and no control threshold is evidenced. The paper itself says candidate diagnostics are unverified, no gate-level diagnostics exist, and it will not state which criteria underlie the qualified label. The grounded evidence is only the control deltas (permuted Spearman drop 1.157 and MAE rise 0.156; constant MAE rise 0.094), measured on one episode on MMLU-Pro with seed 9101.
findings.section: Abstract; Discussion (What the evidence supports); Conclusion

summary: Numbers, tables, and the qualification, development, and held-out caveats match the evidence trail, but two wordings go beyond it: "every error metric" and "passes both negative controls".
